profile.headline: Software Engineer II at AWS
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience in Python, C++, and Javascript developing highly-available infrastructure services for cloud computing and publishing machine learning (ML) research. Strong interest in Linux, software design, and ML.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked on a project to prototype a system architecture for enabling security features on embedded nodes. This consisted of designing the architecture of the multi-computer system and implementing compliant consumers of various security-focused network APIs. There was also substantial work to be done coding, primarily in C++ (on embedded devices) and C# (on windows server devices). All code was written by myself and reviewed by senior software engineers; the architecture was designed by myself and reviewed by the Emerson Architecture and Security teams for optimality in separation of concerns and correctness in security respectively.
The project culminated in (not just the codebase of the prototype and the architectural designs, but also) an extensive report documenting the pitfalls encountered, justifying the architectural design decisions made in real world terms, and expounding upon the path necessary to turn the prototype into a fully-fledged production codebase.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed a progressive web app as a part of a agile team. Participated in daily stand-up and weekly backlog grooming.

Additionally wrote an AI to identify failing sensors in the field from bad data. This saved countless man-hours of combing through data by hand, as well as customer headaches from under-performing equipment, and produced a monthly-run program that flags failing sensors from up-to-date data with a roughly 90% true positive rate. Explored Recurrent Neural Networks, Clustering techniques, and various statistical approaches in tensorflow.

positions.title: Machine Learning Researcher
positions.description: Developed a Recurrent Neural Network to detect and classify atomic gestures from haptic and visual data with an accuracy of 90%. This work was part of a bigger project designed to extract a human's intent while interacting with a VR environment. Wrote and published a paper on the work done, the abstract of which is available here (https://www.researchgate.net/publication/328846867_Sensory_Fusion_and_Intent_Recognition_for_Accurate_Gesture_Recognition_in_Virtual_Environments_13th_International_Symposium_ISVC_2018_Las_Vegas_NV_USA_November_19_-_21_2018_Proceedings)

positions.title: Chemistry Researcher
positions.description:
•  Worked with and categorized organometallic compounds in the Teets lab at the University of Houston.
•  Synthesized various platinum formazanates.
•  Co-authored paper "Spectroscopic and Electrochemical Properties of Electronically-Modified Cycloplatinated Formazanate Complexes"

projects.title: From-Scratch Web Server - C
projects.description:
Designed and implemented a REST API web server, processing HTTP GET, PUT, POST, and DELETE requests
concurrently with a threadpool. Hosting my personal website with this server implementation.

projects.title: Genetic Algorithm Picture Generation -- Java
projects.description: Implemented a genetic algorithm approach to breed user selected pictures represented as function trees over multiple generations.
